summary_rationale: BEML Limited is a 62-year-old Ministry of Defence public sector engineering franchise with >45% domestic market share in metro rolling stock and >50% share in heavy dozers and dumpers, backed by a record ₹21,388 crore order book as of September 30, 2026 (4.9x FY26 sales). However, 10-year financial forensics classify it as CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than a steady compounder: 5-year sales CAGR is 4.11%, 3-year ROE is 8.66% (4.85% TTM), debtor days stretched to 191 days in FY26 alongside a 421-day cash conversion cycle, Free Cash Flow turned negative in expansion years (₹-92 crore in FY25 and ₹-208 crore in FY26), and EBITDA margins compressed from 13% in FY25 to 7% in FY26 and 6.7% in Q2 FY27. Operational KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH because order book visibility and H1 FY27 revenue growth (+36.5% YoY) are strong, but execution must convert backlog into 13%+ operating margins and faster receivable collection without further balance sheet leverage.
